articleTitle: Automotive approach to reduced powertrain emission
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Towards Safer Road Transport - Engineering Solutions
abstract: The authors outline the global issues related to emissions and the contribution made by the motor vehicle in service. Methods being adopted to reduce vehicle emissions are given, and possible long term solutions identified.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Towards Safer Road Transport - Engineering Solutions
abstract: PROMETHEUS is a European Research Programme, which has been approved as a Eureka Project and was launched by the European automotive industry in 1986. The objectives of PROMETHEUS are to reduce road accidents and to improve traffic efficiency. From these two prime objectives additional benefits of reduced environmental pollution, improved driver comfort, reduced driver stress and improved economy are also acquired.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Towards Safer Road Transport - Engineering Solutions
abstract: Automobile electronics have a major role to play in achieving safer road transport, especially if improved safety is to be achieved without sacrificing individual freedom of movement. There are two aspects to any study of safety and automotive electronics. The major area is what can new electronic systems do to reduce the probability and severity of accidents. The second is ensuring that when electronics are introduced they do not cause vehicles to behave in an unpredictable or unintended manner. In order to see how new electronic systems might contribute to safer roads the author looks at why accidents occur and then to look at how electronics might be used to reduce or eliminate some of the principal causes.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Towards Safer Road Transport - Engineering Solutions
abstract: Traffic accidents can be substantially reduced by the use of traffic engineering and management measures including: improved junction provision and design, changes in routes, and better pedestrian facilities. It is clear that traffic engineering provides substantial scope to reduce accidents if the effect of such measures on accident risk has been reliably assessed. The author looks at the development of computer modelling software for provision to traffic authorities to help reduce accidents by means of traffic engineering techniques.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>
